The Answer is 24 Square Inches

For a cube with sides of 2 inches.

lightbulb How did we get this?

A cube has 6 identical square faces. To find the total surface area, you calculate the area of one face and multiply it by 6.

Side Length 2 in
Area of 1 Face 4 sq in
Total Surface Area 6 × 4 = 24 sq in

calculate Interactive Calculator

Try changing values!
1" 5" 10"
1. Area of one face ($s^2$) 2 × 2 = 4 sq in
2. Multiply by 6 faces 6 × 4
Total Surface Area 24 sq in
Volume ($s^3$): 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 cubic inches.
This is how much space is inside the cube.

school Formula Reference

Surface Area

A = 6a²

Where a is the length of one side.

Area of One Face

A = a²

Length × Width (which are the same).

Perimeter of One Face

P = 4a

Distance around one square face.
